protocol_lineage.reason: r1 used a stale CRLF artifact hash; r2 had an unbound C1 builder with a hard-coded study ID; r3 derived exactly one seed but failed before fresh-dataset construction because it compared a current all-arm prompt-manifest metadata identity with the historical v1 commitment. Diagnostics proved that the 300 current ledger prompts match the released model-facing prompt packet exactly, while only the broader manifest identity changed. r4 freezes those 300 released prompt SHA-256 values directly, removes the prior hidden seed from C1, and retains every void attempt. No version issued a model POST.

c0.selection_disclosure: Both service configurations were selected after the old adaptive exploratory study because they completed that interface. This confirmatory study estimates only those two selected configurations and does not represent capable models generally.
c0.immutability_rule: Any change to generator, formal templates, prompt, lane adapter, parser, baseline, hypothesis family, statistics, schedule, or workflow after this file is committed creates a new study version.

design.external_validity_boundary: This is a fresh realization of the same controlled synthetic factor ontology, not a new naturalistic corpus, unseen ontology, fixed-weight model release, or cross-provider replication.
design.seed_failure_rule: The single derived seed is never replaced. Any construction or validation failure makes this version VOID; it cannot trigger reseeding or rejection sampling.

dataset.identifier_rule: Private-seed-keyed permutation into opaque v1-test-cfm-NNN item and pair IDs; evidence, claim, run, and artifact identifiers are consequently regenerated from the new pair IDs.
dataset.template_id_rule: Evaluator-only template_id groups non-formal surface profiles and formal logic templates; it is excluded from model prompts.
dataset.rare_action_limitation: DEMOTE and ESCALATE each have eight items and remain concentrated in one registered factor. Their recall and all four-class macro summaries are fixed-benchmark descriptions, not rare-action factor generalization.

prompt.novelty_gate: All 300 ledger_verifier prompt byte strings must be unique and have zero SHA-256 overlap with the 300 hashes frozen directly from the released model-facing capable-study prompt packet. Semantic factor and template reuse remains disclosed.

formal_lanes.service_identity_rule: The returned alias and any available routing metadata are reported. Missing fingerprint or upstream identity forbids a fixed-weight claim.
The returned alias and any available routing metadata are reported. Missing fingerprint or upstream identity forbids a fixed-weight claim.

execution.worst_case_bound: 300*65 seconds + 299*1 second pacing + 10 second stagger = 330.15 minutes, leaving 29.85 minutes of job safety margin.
execution.durable_intent_rule: A POST_INTENT record is flushed and fsynced before each and only application-level HTTP POST.
execution.service_layer_boundary: Zero retry means zero client-initiated application retry. TCP retransmission and unobservable provider-internal routing or retry are not claimed.

baselines.majority_equivalence: Public-dev majority is ALLOW (50/100) and is exactly the always-ALLOW sanity check; it is never duplicated in the hypothesis family.
baselines.class_prior_boundary: The fixed public-dev shares (0.50, 0.46, 0.02, 0.02) are used only for a deterministic descriptive hash allocation, never as a confirmatory comparator.
baselines.public_only_training_boundary: The serialized NB model was trained before the hidden salt commitment using only the immutable 100-item public dev split. Hidden prediction accepts only the frozen model and prompt packet, not a dataset or gold path.

statistics.primary_outcome: raw end-to-end action correctness with every non-OK cell incorrect
hypotheses: H1: Qwen-service action accuracy <= public-only shallow NB; A1: Qwen-service action accuracy > public-only shallow NB.
H2: Flash-service action accuracy <= public-only shallow NB; A2: Flash-service action accuracy > public-only shallow NB.
statistics.test: For each hypothesis, compute the two-member correctness difference per controlled pair and use the exact one-sided whole-vector within-pair swap/sign-permutation distribution.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down across both registered service-vs-public-only-NB hypotheses, including failed, incomplete, or all-transport-error lanes.
statistics.support_rule: Superiority is supported only when the direction is positive, action-accuracy difference is at least 0.10, and Holm-adjusted p is below 0.05.

per-action recall with NON_OK as false negative

balanced recall across ALLOW HOLD DEMOTE ESCALATE
pair accuracy requiring both members correct

end-to-end and conditional valid promotion rates
statistics.uncertainty_interpretation: Pair/factor/template resampling is benchmark-composition sensitivity only, not model stochastic reliability or natural-world generalization.
statistics.power_analysis_method: Exact pre-hidden pair-sign power using prior exploratory nonzero-pair rates, magnitude-one clipping, the registered 0.10 effect, and Bonferroni alpha 0.025 as a conservative sufficient condition for Holm rejection.

gate.posthoc_interpretation: Any later same-oracle gate result is deterministic implementation conformance only and cannot enter the two hypotheses, abstract model claim, or causal interpretation.

seed.method: One precommitted 32-byte private salt combined by HMAC-SHA256 with this preregistration digest, a future drand quicknet round, and its cryptographically verified randomness.
seed.future_beacon_verification: Pinned official drand-client with hardcoded quicknet chain hash/public key and three agreeing official relays.

reporting.model_claim_unit: OpenCode Go service configuration at the recorded execution time, not a fixed upstream weight artifact.
reporting.replication_claim: The two lanes share one gateway/account and are not independent replications.
